name: Continuous DMRV and Audit Reconciliation
purpose: Continuously reconcile released-batch evidence, environmental observations, QMS/product records, public verification state and audit findings without overwriting historical evidence.
rules: new evidence is appended and linked
material conflicts are surfaced rather than silently averaged
observations retain source, timestamp, location/grid and quality metadata
forecast/modelled/proxy evidence cannot be relabelled as observed
public claims must remain within the evidence and release scope
material corrections require successor DMRV packages and anchors
fail_closed_conditions: successor package missing after material correction
permissible_claims: a defined monitoring period was reconciled
a discrepancy was detected and recorded
a successor evidence version was created
prohibited_claims: release scope automatically applies to new batches
